Teaching and/ or Research Experience:
As per KGMU Statute [10.01(6)] The eligibility criteria - qualification, experience and
publication etc - for various category of teachers mentioned herein before shall be such as
specified for the Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences, Lucknow from time
to time: Provided that minimum eligibility criteria laid down by the Medical Council of
India/Dental Council of India/other regulatory bodies from time to time shall be strictly followed
by the University.
A total of 03, 06, 09 and 13 years of teaching and/or research experience after obtaining the Post
Graduate (for medical)/PhD (for non-medical) degree in a recognized teaching institution is
essential for the posts of Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, Professor Junior Grade
(Additional Professor) and Professor, respectively. Work done as Senior Resident during
DM/M.Ch for Super speciality course or SR for Broad Speciality from a recognized teaching
institute in concerned Speciality will be considered as teaching and/or research experience for
the post of Assistant Professor.
Research publication means only original papers, meta-analysis, systematic reviews, and
case series that are published in journals indexed in Medline, PubMed Central, Science
Citation Index, Citation Index, Expanded Embase, Scopus or Directory of Open Access
Journals and other such journals as may be specified by the Commission from time to
time.
KGMU Faculty Recruitment 2026

Reservation:
 Reservation rules will be applicable as per ‘The Public Services (Reservation for Scheduled
Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward Classes) Act, 1994’ and Government orders issued
from time to time for the domicile of Uttar Pradesh.
 Certificate issued by competent authority on prescribed format of Government of Uttar Pradesh
is required for the claim of any reservation i.e. SC/ST/OBC/PWD.
Person in Service:
Persons working in Government service should submit their application form along with ‘No-
Objection Certificate’ issued by their present employer.
Service conditions etc. shall be applicable as per Act and Statutes of King George’s Medical
University.
KGMU Faculty Recruitment 2026
Page 6
General Conditions:
 Only domicile of Uttar Pradesh can apply.
 Incomplete applications will not be considered and will be rejected. Incomplete application
includes:
 Non deposition of requisite Fees
 Non availability of caste certificate when applicable
 Non submission of Certificate in support of experience.
 Non submission of Certificate of registration of medical qualification by NMC
when applicable.
 Not meeting the desired publications with indexing and authorship.
 For OBC candidates, Certificate should be within Last 06 months.
 In case of women candidates, the Caste Certificate of a person is to be decided on the basis
of her birth in the said community as per UP Government rules will only be treated as valid.
Caste certificate must mention father’s name (but not her husband name)
 UP domicile certificate from relevant authorities.
 No objection certificate from the current employer must be submitted before or be submitted
on the date of interview. (NOC is compulsory for interview)
 The number of posts indicated above is provisional and subject to change without prior
notice.
 Selection may or may not be held for all the advertised posts.
 Latest Reservation Category Certificate issued by the prescribed Competent Authority as per
the prescribed format should be annexed with the application.
 The University will not be responsible if application of any candidate is rejected on the basis
of incomplete or faulty information filled.
 The decision of University in respect of eligibility and suitability of a candidate shall be
final. Vice Chancellor reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning
any reason.
 Documentary proof of experience claimed is a must.
 Candidate will be only be intimated by E-Mail regarding the date of Interview. Original
documents will be verified at the time of Interview.
 Mere eligibility does not entitle a candidate to claim for appointment.
 No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview.
 Only eligible candidates will be called for a personal Interview. Attendance must be in
person, as online appearance is not permitted.
 The appointment shall be subject to certification of medical fitness & verification of the
documents.
 The post is/are whole time & private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited.
 Probation period is for one year which can be extendable for one more year by the competent
authority.
 Jurisdiction is Lucknow Bench of Allahabad High Court only.
KGMU Faculty Recruitment 2026
Page 7
Application Process:
● Only Offline applications will be accepted. Google Form filling is Mandatory. (Link is given
in Application Form.)
● Fresh applications are to be made against this advertisement; no previous application made
against any other advertisement will be considered.
● Application fee: Fees is to be submitted as Demand Draft in favour of A/C No. 50207862810
“KGMU Recruitment” payable at Lucknow.
a. OBC category seats: Rs.6000/-(Inclusive 18% GST) (non-refundable)
b. against SC/ST/PwD category seats: Rs 3500/- (Inclusive 18% GST)(non-refundable)
● Application form with all relevant documents is to be submitted. Incomplete applications will
get rejected.
● Candidates applying for more than one Advertisement Number can make multiple applications
bypaying additional fee.
● No Application will be accepted after the Last Date of Submission.
● All relevant documents and photographs along with self-attested copies of qualifications,
experiences, publications, awards and caste certificates from competent authority of UP
Government (if applicable) and any other relevant documents are to be uploaded in a single pdf
file on given google link upto the last date of submission.
● Duly filled application form along with self-attested copies of all documents should reach
“Registrar, King George’s Medical University, Chowk, Lucknow-226003” By Hand/through
Registered/Speed Post upto the given last date (mentioned above)
● University reserves the right to fill or not to fill all / any of the advertised posts.
● Number of posts can increase or decrease without any assigning any reason & no refund of
payment/application fee will be given.
● University reserves the right to reject any or all applicants without assigning any reason.
● Scrutiny and Screening will be done provisionally by the University of All Applications received
offline. If at any stage, it comes to the knowledge of the University authority that the candidate
has concealed or misrepresented any information, his/ her selection shall be nullified and legal
action will be taken accordingly.
Interview:
Candidates may be short listed for interview by University subject to number of applications against
advertised post wherever required. No T.A./D.A. will be provided.
